Campus Library Borrowing Guide (Fictional Demo)

Standard undergraduate loans last 21 calendar days and may be renewed up to 2 times if no other patron has placed a hold.
Graduate students and Teaching Assistants receive a 42-day standard loan period with up to 3 renewals.
Course reserve textbooks are limited to 4-hour in-library loans.
Overdue fines accrue at $0.50 per day for standard books, capped at $15.00 per item.
